verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਜਲਜ ਅਉ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਸੀਲ ਮੀਨ ਚਕਈ ਕਮਲ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jal jalaj aau jal dhudh seel meen chakiee kamal dhinakar prat preet hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a lotus flower loves water, water has affinity for milk, fish loves water, ruddy Sheldrake and lotus love the sun;

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਚਕੋਰ ਸਸਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਘਨ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਸੁਚੀਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dheepak pata(n)g al kamal chakor sas mirag naadh baadh ghan chaatirak sucheet hai ||

en.bdb: A winged insect (patanga) is attracted to the flame of the light, a black bee is crazy of the fragrance of the lotus flower, a red legged partridge is ever craving for a glimpse of the moon, a deer has affinity for music, while a rain-bird is ever alert for the swati drop.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਿ ਅਉ ਭਤਾਰ ਸੁਤ ਮਾਤ ਜਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਖੁਧਿਆਰਥੀ ਭੋਜਨ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਧਨ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: naar aau bhataar sut maat jal tirakhaava(n)t khudhiaarathee bhojan dhaaridhr dhan meet hai ||

en.bdb: As a wife loves her husband, a son is deeply attached with his mother, a thirsty man craves for water, a hungry for food, and a pauper is always trying to befriend wealth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੨॥
verses.translit_en: maiaa moh dhroh dhukhadhaiee na sahaiee hot gur sikh sa(n)dh mile tiragun ateet hai ||292||

en.bdb: The love of maya is deceitful, its tricks cause suffering and it doesn't accompany us in the finals hours of our life. Love that a Sikh has for his Guru is beyond the influence of maya and supports the Sikh when he departs from this world. (292)
